name: mirage
text: Done and on main: Ozoon, Bovada and Bodog are now one company (Bodog rebranded to Ozoon in Feb 2026 with the same sportsbook), so they count once in the fair line and the books-agree count. From your screenshot I also merged Borgata into BetMGM (it runs the BetMGM platform). I checked BetUS, MyBookie, Bookmaker, Heritage, BetAnySports and Hard Rock Bet and left them separate: I could find no documented shared owner or provider, and I don't merge without proof. The engine picks it up on its next restart (already queued); the app gets it in the next release. Notes: research/book_company_bovada_ozoon_2026-10-22.md
